21_error_root_cause.method: deepest error span (max CHILD_OF ancestor depth) across all error traces of any hotrod service in the last 24 hours; ties broken by earliest trace start then earliest span start

22_critical_path.method: max total critical-path self-time by (service,operation) on the slowest trace of service=frontend in the last 24 hours

23_trace_shape.method: span count + service set of the slowest trace of service=driver in the last 24 hours

24_attribute_hunt.method: tag 'param.driverID' on the earliest-starting failing span of the most recent error trace of service=driver in the last 24 hours

25_dependency.method: direct CHILD_OF callers of service=mysql observed in traces in the last 24 hours, cross-checked against /api/dependencies

26_compare_traces.method: largest positive delta in critical-path self-time by (service,operation) between the fastest and slowest trace of frontend//dispatch in the last 24 hours
